caption: The drawing shows a lace collar in a semi-circular or horseshoe shape, occupying the central part of the image. The lace is depicted in fine detail with intricate floral and geometric patterns, including circular motifs, star-like shapes, and leafy designs. The lace is rendered in white, contrasting against a muted gray background that fills a rectangular area within the slightly darker beige or tan border of the paper. Near the top left corner of the gray area, there is a small, less detailed sketch of the same lace collar seen from a different angle or position, also in a light gray tint. The image is signed "Feuil. N. Tequoit" in small letters at the bottom left corner outside the gray rectangle. The focus of the composition is entirely on the lace collar, with no other prominent objects depicted.
title: Embroidery
